definition: Multi-agent lift is the improvement in clarity, safety, evidence coverage, or implementation quality after accounting for coordination cost and lane authority limits.
criteria: distinct advisory perspectives reduce overclaim risk
App-lane advice remains advisory and does not become proof
CLI/worktree lanes remain separate from callable App lanes
conflicts and missing lanes are recorded as blockers
synthesis produces a better artifact than a single-lane draft

score_scale.0: coordination creates confusion or false authority
score_scale.2: some useful checks but weak synthesis
score_scale.4: strong synthesis with conflicts resolved or bounded
score_scale.5: repeated strong synthesis plus independent verification

current_v464A_v1_assessment.reason: Existing App lanes and CLI branch checks support synthesis, but fresh CLI report runners and repeated independent benchmark runs remain deferred.
